what: Photo slot ([data-fx-part=Hovering over item]) brings up the sticky name row ([data-fx-part=title])’s original name changes straight to that cell’s data-title (client · work name), and returns .1s after the pointer leaves the cell — moving from cell to cell, the next name stays put instead of flickering back first. Text is swapped with no transition

options.back: Time until reverting to the original name after leaving (seconds), default .1
options.[data-fx-part=title]: Name row — inside it [data-fx-part=name] is the original name, [data-fx-part=if swap] is missing, the part creates it
options.[data-fx-part=item]: Cell with data-title (anywhere on the board)
options..is-held: If attached to the name row, it does not switch on hover. The ScrollTrigger on the user side releases it only while the cells pass beneath the name row

use:
Studio Name

…
note: Not applied on touch devices (hover false) — the original name stays as is

from.where: index.html .home-inner: intro text pinned to the top of the screen (difference, white text) whose leading studio name changes to the data-title of the photo grid cell below. Before the cell grid head touches the bottom of the intro text and after it reaches the end list, is-held applies (original no-title-change)
